name: Angelique Maren no Rokukishi
original_name: アンジェリーク 魔恋の六騎士
source:
Teresa has been living a normal life with Renaud, who is like a younger brother to her, until odd disappearances start happening across town. First Teresa was abducted, and although she returned home unharmed, she remembered nothing about the incident. Her family decided to put it behind them, but soon Renaud disappears, and unlike in Teresa's case, he has been gone for days.

While searching for her brother, Teresa reached a fortress. There, Renaud was entertaining some sort of notion that he has become the leader of a group of knights. Determined to take her brother home, Teresa poses as one in the team to find out what happened.

[Edited from [url=http://www.play-asia.com]Play-Asia[/url]]
translation:
特蕾莎一直与如同弟弟一般的鲁诺过着平静的生活，直到镇上接连发生离奇失踪事件。最初，被绑走的是特蕾莎。她虽然毫发无伤地回到家中，却完全不记得期间发生了什么。家人决定不再追究此事，可没过多久，鲁诺也失踪了；与特蕾莎不同，他一连数日都杳无音信。

寻找弟弟的过程中，特蕾莎来到一座要塞。她发现鲁诺不知为何坚信自己已经成了一支骑士团的首领。特蕾莎决意带弟弟回家，于是乔装成团员混入其中，试图查明事情的真相。

[据[url=http://www.play-asia.com]Play-Asia[/url]编辑]
